source_article.title: Neural networks enable efficient and accurate simulation-based inference of evolutionary parameters from adaptation dynamics

inspected_artifact.verification: SHA-1 of ASCII blob + space + decimal byte length + NUL + decoded bytes equals API blob SHA and tree member SHA; decoded size equals API size. SHA-256 computed independently.
inspected_artifact.version_scope: Content-addressed blob in inspected HEAD tree; exact publication-execution version unverified.

repository_inventory.interpretation: Complete returned tree of this snapshot, not a claim about all branches, history, or separate deposits.

facts.operation: Read clone fitness estimates and remove any clone identifier containing DGY1657.
facts.meaning: Explicit ancestor-label exclusion; substring matching, not an exact-equality key.

facts.operation: Keep only rows with fitness_coef greater than zero for the competition-assay distribution.
facts.meaning: Positive coefficient selection; no significance threshold at this step. It does not establish correspondence to the 18 significantly higher-fitness clones reported in 2018.
facts.missingness_policy: Rows that fail to yield a true positive-coefficient predicate are not retained; input missing cells and count uninspected.
facts.scope_assessment: Consistent with the article’s stated beneficial-variant distribution comparison; not evidence of a coding error and not an all-clone distribution.

facts.operation: Read competition points and select strain DGY1734 for the example plot.
facts.meaning: An explicit example-strain selector; actual stock, genotype and run joins remain unverified.

facts.operation: Attach filtered-barcode identifiers to fitness rows by column binding, set population label bc01, then left join CNV labels by barcode and population.
facts.meaning: First alignment relies on row order; subsequent key join may depend on uniqueness. Input order, row counts, alias validity and key cardinality were not inspected.

facts.operation: Read six generation columns (5,37,62,99,124,149), retain listed barcodes and assign population label bc01.
facts.meaning: Literal code mapping of bc04 input names to bc01; not an independently authenticated biological alias crosswalk.

facts.operation: Following the left join, missing CNV labels become noCNV.
facts.meaning: Absence-of-match label; no independent DNA-negative truth or sensitivity denominator is supplied by this operation.

facts.operation: For the barcode DFE comparison retain CNV-labelled rows with Mutation_Fitness greater than zero.
facts.meaning: Positive estimate and joined-label selection; not significance testing or independent mutation-birth certification.

facts.operation: For the plotted trajectories require a positive generation-5 count and remove four specified patterns with a zero at one sampled time followed by a positive count at the next; normalize each retained time column by its retained sum.
facts.meaning: The plotted counts are conditional on filtering. No removed-row count, total-event count or correction magnitude was recovered.

facts.operation: Read estimated parameters from a directory named single116 and retain NPE/NSF/100000 settings for the distribution comparison.
facts.meaning: Model-derived estimates enter as a separate source stream; these are not direct mutation observations.

original_clone_workbook.interpretation: Metadata and source article authenticate candidate identity, not workbook contents or clone membership.
